stops.name: Sierra de Castril es un parque
stops.detail: La Sierra de Castril () is a Spanish natural park and its largest figure in the town of Castril (north of Granada). It goes from north to south through the river of the same name - the Castrel River - and its main feature is its spectacular relief, fruit of the limeic nature of the ground, precipitations at the peaks and water action.
